# capi_kubeconfig (Ephemeral Resource)

A workload cluster's kubeconfig for the life of a Terraform run, never written to state. With `secrets` unset it is read from the `<cluster>-kubeconfig` Secret on the management cluster the provider block names, the way `clusterctl get kubeconfig` reads it. With `secrets` set to a `capi_cluster`'s `provider_secrets` it is derived instead: a client certificate for `system:masters`, valid for `ttl`, signed by the cluster CA those secrets carry. That is how a self-managed cluster is reached, since no other authority holds a credential for it. Feed `raw` to the `capi`, `kubernetes` or `helm` provider blocks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A short-lived kubeconfig for the workload cluster, never written to state.
ephemeral "capi_kubeconfig" "prod" {
  cluster   = capi_cluster.prod.name
  namespace = "capi"
  ttl       = "1h"
}

provider "kubernetes" {
  alias                  = "prod"
  host                   = ephemeral.capi_kubeconfig.prod.host
  cluster_ca_certificate = ephemeral.capi_kubeconfig.prod.cluster_ca_certificate
  client_certificate     = ephemeral.capi_kubeconfig.prod.client_certificate
  client_key             = ephemeral.capi_kubeconfig.prod.client_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster` (String) Cluster name.

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) API server URL the derived kubeconfig points at, e.g. `https://10.0.0.160:6443`. Required with `secrets`; a `capi_cluster`'s `status.endpoint`.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the Cluster object on the management cluster. Default `default`.
- `secrets` (Dynamic, Sensitive) A `capi_cluster`'s `provider_secrets`: the Talos machine-secrets bundle or the kubeadm CA of a self-managed cluster. When set, the kubeconfig is derived from it and nothing is read from a management cluster.
- `ttl` (String) Validity of a derived client certificate, as a Go duration. Default `1h`.

### Read-Only

- `client_certificate` (String, Sensitive) PEM client certificate, when the kubeconfig authenticates with one.
- `client_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM client key, when the kubeconfig authenticates with a certificate.
- `cluster_ca_certificate` (String) PEM cluster CA certificate.
- `host` (String) API server URL of the kubeconfig's current context.
- `raw` (String, Sensitive) The kubeconfig.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token, when the kubeconfig authenticates with one.
